notes: Pinned benchmark slices for LARA. A 'slice' is a named, reproducible set of task IDs + parameters. The autonomous loop references slices by name so that runs from different sessions are directly comparable; raw 'benchmark.py --app venmo --n 5' is not stable because the underlying keyword filter can drift. Update task_ids only when you deliberately want to expand or reshape a slice (record why in 'change_log').

venmo-smoke-5.purpose: Fast iteration on venmo + phone failures. First 5 of the 21 venmo-tagged train tasks; covers the 2a163ab (like-roommates social feed) and afc0fce (comment+like coworker payments) families that dominate today's failure analysis.
